name: ai-buddy
title: AI Buddy
description: AI helpers for daily work: translate, reply and rewrite text with any OpenAI-compatible LLM
author: tranthaison1231

commands.name: reply
commands.title: Buddy Draft Reply
commands.description: Draft a reply for the selected chat messages; tweak it with your own idea

commands.name: rewrite
commands.title: Buddy Polish English
commands.description: Polish the selected English draft: correct grammar, natural wording, plus lessons to learn

commands.name: summarize
commands.title: Buddy Summarize
commands.description: Summarize selected text, chat threads, emails, or docs into TL;DR, key points, and action items

commands.name: result
commands.title: Buddy Home
commands.description: Home: guide, settings and quick run for Translate / Draft Reply / Polish English / Summarize

preferences.name: activeProvider
preferences.title: Active Provider
preferences.description: Select which AI provider to use. Configure its API key and model in the matching section below.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Interface language. AI content (translations, Vietnamese meanings, lessons) is not affected.

preferences.name: polishMode
preferences.title: Polish English Mode
preferences.description: Choose whether Buddy Polish English opens the review popup or replaces the selected text immediately.

preferences.name: fastMode
preferences.title: Speed
preferences.label: Skip model thinking (faster)
preferences.description: Disables or minimizes model thinking where supported (retried without it if unsupported).

preferences.name: geminiApiKey
preferences.title: Google Gemini · API Key
preferences.description: API key from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

preferences.name: groqModel
preferences.title: Groq · Model
preferences.description: Model name for Groq (e.g. qwen/qwen3.8-27b or openai/gpt-oss-20b).

preferences.name: openaiModel
preferences.title: OpenAI · Model
preferences.description: Model name for OpenAI (e.g. gpt-5-mini or gpt-4.1-nano).

preferences.name: customBaseUrl
preferences.title: Custom · Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for Cerebras, OpenRouter, Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1), LiteLLM…

preferences.name: customApiKey
preferences.title: Custom · API Key
preferences.description: API key for the custom endpoint (leave empty for local Ollama).

preferences.name: customModel
preferences.title: Custom · Model
preferences.description: Model name at the custom endpoint.

preferences.name: mwKey
preferences.title: Merriam-Webster Key
preferences.description: Free Learner's Dictionary key from dictionaryapi.com for dictionary IPA. Optional: without it Wiktionary / AI is used.

scripts.share: npm test && bash scripts/pack.sh && open -R share/AI-Buddy.zip
